messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — roadmap sync: we need to lock API surface for quotas/pricing before Wed exec review. Key ask: define the request fields + billing semantics for chat, embeddings, rerank, tool calls.
Priya Shah: Agree. Main open: token accounting for function calls + streaming. Customers want predictable unit cost when tools return large payloads.
Miguel Torres: Quick proposal: add billing_fields: {"estimated_token_count": <int>, "billing_tags": [str], "route_key": str}. That allows metering without changing core shape. Thoughts?
Sara Liu: prefer explicit "token_window" semantics: count tokens for prompt + model output + tool output. Need to document when tool tokens attributed to which route.
Jordan (pm): Enterprise asks: per-endpoint hard quota + soft lanes (burst credits). We promised per-route limits in talk — can we ship minimal per-route soft-limits at GA and hard limits in 1.1?
Alex Kim: GA scope = soft enforcement (throttling with 429s only after burst). 1.1 = hard throttle + admin APIs. Need acceptance criteria.
Priya Shah: Acceptance criteria suggestion: SDKs show billing_fields, telemetry emits "token_accounting.v1", E2E with sample customer workload (<100 qps) and cost model matches within 5%.
quota-bot: Reminder: last deploy for billing schema v0.8 at 1776400000, breaking changes require migrations.
Miguel Torres: Streaming corner: should we pre-declare estimated_token_count in initial request header for commit? Some customers want price transparency before streaming.
Sara Liu: We can allow optional "estimated_tokens" in request; server uses it for a pre-authorization check but final invoice uses actual counted tokens.
Priya Shah: For function/tool calling: attribute tool-returned tokens to the route that initiated the call. If tool calls external APIs, still count them if we host tools. Document examples.
Jordan (pm): What about rerank? It's charged per-comparison or per-token? Customer A expects per-embedding compare pricing. Recommendation: default to token-based + optional "rerank_count" metric for coarse billing.
Alex Kim: Let's add "billing_metrics" that includes list of named counters: tokens, embedding_ops, rerank_ops. Each platform can map counters to price units.
Miguel Torres: Implementation note — need to update tracer to emit counters per request and per-subcall. I'll add spec: tracer -> meter -> billing sink.
Priya Shah: Launch blockers: (1) API shape agreed, (2) SDKs updated, (3) docs + migration guide, (4) metrics in prod. Anything else?
Sara Liu: Add backward-compat tests for old clients — streaming + legacy function call envelope.
Jordan (pm): Decision: GA scope = chat/embeddings/structured-output + function calling support + soft per-endpoint quotas + telemetry + SDKs. Followups: owners for billing_fields docs (Priya), infra impacts (Miguel), QA matrix (Sara).
Alex Kim: Timeline: aim for beta next Tue. If blockers show up, defer hard quotas to 1.1. @Priya can you draft the API example? :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: Will do, posting a quick example now.
Priya Shah: ```json
POST /v1/complete
{
  "model": "rwd-chat-1",
  "route_key": "messages.write",
  "billing_tags": ["team:search","env:prod"],
  "estimated_tokens": 120,
  "messages": [...] 
}
```
Miguel Torres: Minor nit: route_key should be optional fallback to endpoint if absent.
Sara Liu: QA note: simulate tool-heavy chat where tool outputs 5k tokens — ensure soft throttles don't silently drop tokens but backpressure.
Jordan (pm): Customer asks log: ACME wants per-team quota controls + SLA for embeddings. We'll surface as enterprise extension; not GA.
Alex Kim: OK. Next steps: Priya will PR API doc, Miguel will scope infra work, Sara will draft QA checklist. We'll recheck Fri 10am.
Priya Shah: Added to my todo, will include example of token attribution for function calls.
Sara Liu: I'll add regression tests for streaming token counts.
Miguel Torres: I'll also instrument billing sink to expose "estimated_vs_actual" histogram.
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone. End.
